text:
Celia M: Heads-up — NimbusHW sent the microsite bundle (logos, case PDF, and a short customer video). Need quick review: badge + lockup rules, HSM icon placement on the solution diagram, video thumbnail frame, alt text, and legal consent for the quote. Target: get assets into staging by Fri 16:00 PT.
Noah R: Thanks. Are they providing a reversed-white mark for dark backgrounds? Also confirm whether the HSM manufacturer logo needs separate attribution per their brand guide.
Partner: NimbusHW: We uploaded a zip to the shared drive: https://files.redwood.com/nimbushw/microsite_bundle_v1.zip. Included SVGs (full, reversed, compact), a 16:9 MP4 clip (00:00:45), a 2-page case PDF, and a brand guide PDF that requests the HSM logo appear with a 6px clearspace and the attribution "HSM provided by Nimbus Hardware" when used on product pages.
DesignOps: Downloaded. Immediate notes: 1) The reversed-white SVG has a thin stroke artifact at 1x PNG exports — will re-export with a tiny 0.5px stroke fix. 2) The recommended hero layout uses horizontal lockup; at <540px the HSM icon collides with the CTA. We should stack the HSM badge under the core logo at breakpoint. 3) Video thumbnail: partner supplied a frame that is too dark; need a contrast-safe play icon and a 4px inner stroke to meet AA for the overlay play button.
Priya S: Marketplace/meta constraints: title <= 60 chars, short_desc <= 140 chars, alt text <= 125 chars. Also the case PDF needs a one-line summary for the case list (<= 200 chars) and a quote attribution format: "— Name, Title, Company". Legal wants signed consent for the quote in the PDF.
LegalBot: Received a draft consent but line 3 is missing the partner sign-off date. Please ask Nimbus to initial and date section 3. Until then we can't publish the quote verbatim. We can publish the asset without the quote.
Partner: NimbusHW: Noted. We've re-uploaded the consent with dates: doc id NH-AG-0426-signed. Also confirm HSM logo attribution ok: "HSM provided by Nimbus Hardware" — approved.
Celia M: Great. DesignOps, can you produce: SVG reversed + PNG 1x/2x for compact mark, stacked lockup at mobile break, hero preview (1200x420) and video thumbnail (1280x720) with an accessible play icon? Also add alt text file and a short summary.
DesignOps: Will do. Export checklist I'll push to the folder:
- compact-mark.svg
- compact-mark@1x.png (140x140)
- compact-mark@2x.png (280x280)
- hero-preview.png (1200x420)
- video-thumb.png (1280x720) with play overlay (white play + #002a80 stroke 4px)
- stacked-lockup.svg + stacked-lockup@1x.png
- metadata.txt with alt text and marketplace strings
CSS snippet for stacked lockup at <540px:
```css
@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .brand-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .hsm-badge { order: 2; }
}
```
Noah R: For the video thumb, ensure the play icon contrast checks pass on both light and dark variants. Also export a neutral blurred frame for low-bandwidth placeholder (600x338 webp).
DesignOps: Noted. Alt text proposals in metadata file: 
- compact mark alt: "Nimbus Hardware compact mark" (30 chars)
- hero alt: "Nimbus Hardware and Redwood Inference joint solution for secure LLM inference" (84 chars)
- video alt: "Demo: deploying on-prem inference with Nimbus HSM and Redwood Inference" (82 chars)
I'll ensure each stays <=125 chars and add the short summary: "Nimbus Hardware and Redwood Inference reduced key-management overhead and preserved low-latency inference in regulated environments." (129 chars)
Priya S: Short summary is slightly over 200 chars? Marketplace wants <=200 for list, and the one-line case header <=140. Please provide a 140-char one-line summary for the case list.
DesignOps: Revised strings:
- one_line_headline (<=140): "Nimbus Hardware + Redwood: secure, low-latency on-prem LLM inference" (76 chars)
- case_summary (<=200): "Joint deployment with Nimbus Hardware integrated HSM-based key management with Redwood's runtime to maintain sub-50ms P95 latency and simplified compliance." (158 chars)
LegalBot: Consent verified (NH-AG-0426-signed). Quote in PDF is approved: use attribution format "— Leena Park, Director of Ops, Nimbus Hardware". Please ensure the exact punctuation and title match the signed doc.
Celia M: Perfect. PartnerOps, can you confirm the file path with the new exports once DesignOps uploads them? We'll then run staging checks (accessibility + mobile layout).
Partner: NimbusHW: Uploaded updated assets to https://files.redwood.com/nimbushw/exports_v2.zip. Files include metadata.txt and signed consent.
Noah R: I'll run the accessibility checks on CTA contrast and play icon now. Will also test stacked lockup at 360px and 412px width. Ping back with results in ~30m.
DesignOps: Upload complete. In metadata.txt I've included exact marketplace strings, alt text, credit line: "Partner: Nimbus Hardware — Leena Park, Director of Ops" and a note on HSM attribution placement.
Noah R: Accessibility checks: CTA contrast passes at hero overlay with #00307a background and white text; play icon with 4px #002a80 stroke also passes. Stacked lockup displays correctly at 360px with 8px top/bottom spacing. Video placeholder (600x338) loads and looks ok.
Priya S: I'll paste final marketplace strings (valid lengths):
- title (<=60): "Nimbus Hardware + Redwood Inference" (36 chars)
- short_desc (<=140): "Secure, low-latency on-prem LLM inference with HSM-backed key management and predictable throughput." (119 chars)
- alt_text (<=125): "Nimbus Hardware compact mark for secure on-prem inference with HSM" (78 chars)
- one_line_case (<=140): "Nimbus Hardware + Redwood: secure, low-latency on-prem LLM inference" (76 chars)
LegalBot: Confirm final credit line and quote attribution match signed consent. All good.
Celia M: Awesome work. Final checklist: 1) DesignOps uploaded exports (done); 2) PartnerOps confirmed upload link (done); 3) LegalBot verified consent (done); 4) Noah ran AA and layout checks (done); 5) Priya will schedule staging publish and localization. I'll give final publish approval once localized FR/DE strings are attached. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
